construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Metal generating Water same-polarity — precision as the source sustaining depth
candidates.k2_overview: Your Metal moves as the Alchemist: a mind that refines. You take raw knowledge and smelt it, testing claims, discarding slag, keeping only what rings true when struck. Your insight is assay-grade and arrives in solitude. Share the refined ingots. The lonely part of the craft is the furnace, not the life.
candidates.k2_functional: You think by refinement: melt the claim, pour off error, keep the metal.

k2_domain_readings.Learning: You learn by testing: every teaching struck against evidence before acceptance. Slow intake, permanent retention. Choose dense material worth the smelting. Shallow content wastes your furnace.
k2_domain_readings.Intuition: Your intuition is metallurgical: a felt sense for what is alloyed with falsehood. When something rings wrong, it is wrong. Trust the ear and verify the details later.
k2_domain_readings.Solitude: Solitude is your workshop: insight forms only with the door closed. Guard those hours without apology. Just open the shop some evenings. Refined gold unshared stays ore.

angles.drive: You test everything before you let it in. A fact only becomes yours once tried against something real, and that puts testing ahead of simply learning. Keep the slow filter, and what you know stays yours for good.
angles.cost_self: Testing everything costs you time. Slow and sure means more to you than quick and wrong, so most of your learning starts late. Let one good teacher skip the test, because every hour spent proving the known is an hour not spent learning the new.
angles.cost_others: Whenever someone hands you a fact, you test it in front of them. Trying it yourself matters more than being agreeable, and whoever offered it gets a question instead of thanks. If you test it later in private, you keep both fact and goodwill.

angles.drive: You are rarely fooled. Being fooled by a person costs you more than being slow to trust one, so you weigh the uneasy feeling ahead of the proof. When a kind person proves your doubt wrong, being fooled by kindness is a loss worth taking.
angles.cost_self: Rarely fooled, you are slow to be glad. You check an offer for the catch before letting it near, and would rather miss a good thing than be fooled. Once you take an offer at its word, you get back what your doubt sends away.
angles.cost_others: You check an honest word as closely as a false one. Being hard to fool counts for more with you than being easy company, and you make a truthful person prove it twice. You keep more honest company with every first answer you let stand.

angles.drive: Your best thinking happens alone. You need quiet for a half-formed idea more than an audience, so you shut the door until it is whole. Each time you bring one person in at the halfway point, you keep the quiet and lose only the loneliness.
angles.cost_self: Thinking alone keeps the idea clean. You would rather carry a hard question alone than let anyone see it unsolved, and help only reaches a problem someone has heard about. Once you tell one person early, help you have done without starts arriving.
angles.cost_others: Your thinking stays private until it is a result for others. Working it out alone comes easier to you than together, and the people near you get only the conclusion. When you open the door earlier, you give them a say in the deciding.

angles.drive: You are never done checking. Letting a thing out early feels like a mistake you cannot undo, so you check once more rather than hand it over. You stopped finding errors long ago and now check for comfort.
angles.cost_self: Checking a thing again feels safer than handing it in. You would rather send it late and right than early and good enough, and the late ones mostly never go. You lose more chances to the extra check than to the errors it catches.
angles.cost_others: Whenever someone asks, you reply only once the answer is fully checked. Late sits easier with you than wrong, and you leave whoever asked waiting on your standard instead of your reply. You spend their time on each extra check for your own peace.

angles.drive: Precision matters to you past the point of being followed. A near-enough answer feels like a small lie to you, so you give the precise one rather than the easy one. Most days you get one of exact or understood, and one is enough.
angles.cost_self: Being exact costs you people who talk loosely. You correct a small error in a story rather than let it land, and over time fewer people tell you much. You wanted to be told more than you wanted it exact, and that is worth remembering.
angles.cost_others: Handed a rough idea, you give it back exact. You would rather fix the wording than hear what it was for, and the one who brought it gets a correction instead of a reply. You leave them corrected when they came to be heard.

angles.drive: Hard to reach is what you become mid-thought. You need it whole before anyone touches it, so you let messages wait rather than answer half-minded. You get the thought back more easily than the person.
angles.cost_self: Being hard to reach keeps the thinking clean and the evenings empty. You would rather answer a thought than a person, and over time you get asked less. You give up closeness for the quiet, and every call you let ring out proves it.
angles.cost_others: Reaching you means waiting for a thought to finish first. You put the unfinished idea ahead of the person at the door, and your silence lands as the answer. You hold back your company from them until the thought is done.

edge.lead: Metal runs through your mind, your growth and your career. It is the wrong note you catch while the music sounds fine, the odd way of learning that only works for you, and the fix built from a spare part that holds for good.
